page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 32 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration, the server is equipped with two NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units, delivering a combined total of 16 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met using external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this hardware profile offers a balanced allocation of dedicated compute cores and system memory alongside dual entry-level enterprise GPUs. This configuration is suitable for workloads that benefit from GPU acceleration but do not require high-end modern GPU architectures. Appropriate workloads include video transcoding, low-latency inference, media processing, and general-purpose GPU-assisted computing.
